query:
SELECT q.value ->> 'idx' AS "idx!: i64", MAX(e.event_id) AS "last_event_id?: i64"
                FROM json_each($1) q
                    LEFT JOIN flow_configuration_events e
                        ON e.flow_type = q.value ->> 'flow_type' AND e.scope_data = q.value ->> 'scope_data'
                GROUP BY q.value ->> 'idx'
